text:
emma: Quick pulse — noticed a big cohort spike on the launch dashboard right after Wednesday's webinar. Can we confirm lead routing + attribution? 

ravi: looking... GA shows a +420 session bump at 14:05 UTC, UTMs look intact for most traffic. SFDC leads are delayed by ~30m though. 

clare: are we seeing increased organic or paid? the campaign tag on some links is missing (utm_campaign=) so that might default to 'none'. 

emma: hmm. weird. the webinar CTA used a short link from our slides repo — could that strip params? @jordan can you check link redirect logs? 

jordan: on it — pulling redirect logs now. initial hit shows referrer=slides.redwood.com, redirect 302 -> short.red/rvw which preserves querystring. but our CDN logs show a small subset (≈6%) dropping querystring on GET. 

ravi: that explains discrepancies between GA and HubSpot lists. GA still picks up sessions but the contact form hits lose campaign tag sometimes so HubSpot attribution goes to 'Direct'. 

clare: so dashboard funnels show conversion up but attributed to Organic/Direct. we should avoid alert fatigue — want a quick patch and a longer fix. 

emma: Suggestion: 1) short-term: add a UTM fallback rule in ETL that maps referrer slides.redwood.com -> 'webinar-ember' for last-touch attribution. 2) mid-term: fix CDN redirect behavior. 3) add note in dashboard about 'partial UTM loss' for this cohort. 

jordan: agree. I'll file an infra ticket for CDN config, and tag eng-oncall if it's urgent. 

ravi: i can add the ETL fallback today — will update data pipeline docs. 

clare: can we also add a small eval: run cohort conversion comparison with and without fallback for transparency in the KPI email? 

emma: yes pls. let's aim to surface both numbers in tomorrow's weekly KPI email. i'll draft a short paragraph for comms. 

dashbot: deploy scheduled: ETL mapping change by ravi — staging -> prod in 2h. 

jordan: infra ticket filed: #INF-4821, assigning to @eng-infra. ETA EOD. 

ravi: mapping merged to main, starting prod deploy. will post when done. 

ravi: prod deploy complete. quick sanity check: cohort attribution now shows 18% reclassified from 'Direct' -> 'webinar-ember'. dashboard widgets refreshed. 

clare: looks good on the dashboard. please add a footnote to the KPI slide deck and tag the raw query in the doc. 

emma: perfect. thanks team. i'll mention this in the KPI email and link #INF-4821 and the ETL PR. :rocket:
